subject: Science
definition: Motion is a core concept in Science — Kinematics — distance, displacement, speed, velocity and acceleration.

objectives.text: Students will be able to define key terms related to motion.
Students will be able to explain the underlying principles of motion.
Students will be able to apply motion concepts to solve numerical problems.

advantages: Builds a strong conceptual foundation for later Science chapters.
Connects theory to everyday observable examples.
disadvantages: Can feel abstract without hands-on demonstration.
realWorldApplications: Used in engineering and design contexts related to motion.
Appears in common technology and everyday devices.
commonMisconceptions: Students often confuse related terms within motion.
suggestedAnalogies: Compare motion to a familiar daily-life scenario for easier recall.

keyVocabulary.definition: Definition of key term 1 related to motion.
Definition of key term 2 related to motion.
Definition of key term 3 related to motion.

differentiationNotes.slowLearners: Provide a simplified worksheet with worked examples.
differentiationNotes.advancedLearners: Offer an extension problem connecting to a real-world case study.
